name: Spawner
description: Makes copies of a prefab appear while playing — on a click, when a player walks in, on a timer, or when another script asks. Copies appear at the Spawner's own spot, only on this player's client.

changelog.notes: Initial release: copies of a prefab appear while playing — on a click, when a player walks in, on a timer, or when another Script asks — made on that player's own client, with a per-spot cap, a lifetime and scatter.
